data_fields.name: luck_rerolls_per_pack
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 re-roll on the first miss (AOS only)

data_fields.name: max_bonus_props
data_fields.donor_constant: MaxProps per entry, e.g. 4 for AosAverage type 1 entry

data_fields.name: dice_quantity
data_fields.donor_constant: XdY+Z string, e.g. 5d10+50 for gold in AosAverage

best_idea: A per-entry chance table with one weighted pick per drop, and damage-share looting rights measured against the top hitter, is a small server-side loot step for many-on-one kills.
decision_why: The shape fits server-verified kills and MAX_ATTACKERS = 3, but the luck stat and the 2007 first-hitter 1.25x rule are UO-specific; they become data fields with defaults or are dropped.
acceptance: A server test kills a boss with three attackers under a seeded RNG, asserts the same drop list twice, asserts the first hitter's damage is weighted 1.25x for the rights check, and asserts a third attacker below top/8 at HitsMax >= 1000 gets no drop roll.
